name: Sunday Chateau En Ville - Pattaya
detail: The location was peaceful and perfect for a relaxing stay.

name: Sunday Beachfront View Jomtien Pattaya
detail: My room is quite good and clean. Only one thing that I really disappoint with this hotel is service management. I booked 3-nights room with large bed (double bed) not twins bed; studio room type. when I arrived at the hotel for checking in, the staff gave me the room with a twins bed. I request him changing to room with large bed (double bed) immediately. He told me there is no available studio room that has a large bed. OK, instead, I also asked him changing to another room type with large bed, I can pay different price. He insisted that there is no any available room for me. VERY DISAPPOINTED!!!! It takes me about 10 mins waiting him to resolve the issue. After he called to someone who has more authorize, he gave me another room type with a large bed. WHAT???? What about I ask him before??? Everything in this hotel is OK. but for me, I just have a bad luck when I check in.

name: Aya Boutique Hotel
detail: I liked this hotel very much. For the money it is a great bargain. It's clean, in a great location, centrally located around Soi 13 half way between the madness at soi 5 and walking street. The room is high end because this is a newer property so it's modern looking. I didn't really like that it had a bath tub rather then a stand up shower but this is definitely not a negative. The fact that the show has no door also is a bit annoying but most places in Thailand seem to be the same. The one dowside to this hotel is the pool. I have no idea why but that stuck the pool on the 2nd or 3rd poor. It's sort of an indoor pool with about 10% of the pool outdoors in the sun and the the rest of the pool shaded. For this reason not many people use the pool which is nice, but the water is cold because most of the pool gets no sun. This is really the only negative I could find about this hotel. Everything else is wonderful and I would say it's one of the best boutique hotels in Pattaya for the money, about $65 USD.

name: Arbour Hotel and Residence Pattaya
detail: The room are beautiful and amazing the swimming pool.

name: Pooh Beach Resort & Spa
detail: I had a very enjoyable stay and I will come back again soon.

name: Dusit Thani Pattaya
detail: We stayed at the Dusit Hua Hin last year for our anniversary, but this year we thought we'd try the Pattaya location. From parking the car to walking into the lobby, it's a rush of nice. The place just smells nice. There is an obvious emphasis to detail here. The room was comfortable and quiet. Bathroom great. Rain shower. Nice big balcony. I think this is better than the other hotels in Pattaya of similar rankings. Reason is, this one is actually on the beach, AND it is also on the main bay, overlooking all the other hotels which are NOT on the beach. So you have the best of it all. You walk down to the ground level and go to the beach right out your door. No crossing the street. Then, from your balcony, you sit and enjoy the great view of the Pattaya Bay with all the activity and the cool Pattaya sign lit up at night. Food wasn't that great we don't think. I think they have the effort, but need some new recipes. Not sure. It was just missing the wow factor. The pool was nice. Tennis courts on the water. Great view. Good service. Really clean. We'll be back again.

name: March Hotel
detail: March hotel is a brand new property which provides you with best in class amenities within affordable price. I booked this hotel from Agoda with expectations of getting a class facility similar to April and August suites as the owner is same - and the hotel exceeded my expectations - I have previously stayed in April suites also so I trusted this new property - really they kept my trust. This hotel is managed, staffed and maintained to the highest degree and is excellent value for money. It is Located near to Tops supermarket( Central Pattaya) in a quiet street (very common in Thailand provincial towns), but the nightlife is only 3-4 minutes away. This may not be a 5 start luxury hotel but the interior design, decoration and layout makes it a very comfortable stay. The balcony is big, the fridge is big, the pool is well designed - in short it is much better than many of the 4 star establishments in Pattaya and elsewhere. I stayed with my 4 friends and one couple - all of them may not be free to write a review but on their behalf too it was rated the best value for money hotel. The receptionist Miss Julia took great care for all of us - she is very polite and caring. We started our stay very next day of the Grand opening of the hotel and I am sure the standards will be maintained in the coming years too. To close this review at last I would like to add - I really enjoyed my stay here, believe me and you will also.

name: COSI Pattaya Wong Amat Beach
detail: Very nice budget hotel, nice under water speakers in the pool! Room clean, friendly staff. Short walk from beach but a bit out from the action of Pattaya but only a short taxi ride away. Great price. Seems to be a popular area for Russian people, mainly familys.

name: Sunday JA Plus Hotel
detail: Agoda mapped this incorrectly on the map. It is ON 3rd Pattaya street (2 streets farther east than shown), so it was too far away from the action, and I walk! Internet was excellent, but given in 7 hour increments before you have to request another ticket. Front desk staff were incredibly friendly and very helpful, even if little English was spoken. The internet had 99% uptime, so I'm happy. The breakfast was decent for an included price.
